design_corrected_flow_TMX.quote: Corrected speed, 10 720 rpm; corrected flow, 184.20 lbm/sec (83.55 kg/sec).

rotor1_tip_speed.quote: With a required first rotor tip-speed of 1450 ft/sec (441.96 m/sec), the design speed corrected to standard inlet conditions is 10,720 rpm.

rotor1_inlet_tip_diameter.quote: The first rotor inlet tip diameter was selected as 31 inches (0.787 m)

per_row_design_performance.quote: TABLE I DESIGN PERFORMANCE (rows Rotor 1, Stator 1, Rotor 2, Stator 2)

igv.quote: The fan was designed without inlet guide vanes (IGV) but with the provision for adding a variable camber IGV at a later date.

stator_exit_flow_angle.quote: The vanes for both stator rows were designed to have zero exit flow angle at all radii and to be resettable +-10 degrees (.17 radians) from the design stagger in increments of 2.5 degrees (0.044 radians).

annulus_blockages_data_reduction.quote: TABLE VI. - ANNULUS BLOCKAGES (Data reduction column; design column identical except last row 3.5)

profile_type.quote: Rotor and stator blade sections for both stages of the fan are multiple-circular-arc (MCA) airfoils designed on conical surfaces which approximate streamsurfaces of revolution.

rotor_transition_point.unit: fraction of distance LE to normal shock location on suction surface
rotor_transition_point.quote: The ratio of front-chord to total-chord was set to provide a transition point 0.8 of the distance from the leading edge to the normal shock location on the suction surface (point B in Figure 12).

rotor_tc_distribution.value: rotor 1 hub 0.08, rotor 2 hub 0.095, linear to 0.025 at tip
rotor_tc_distribution.quote: Rotor 1 has a hub t/c of 0.08 and a partspan shroud at 61 percent span from the hub. Rotor 2 has a hub t/c of 0.095 but no partspan shroud. Spanwise distributions of t/c for both rotors are linear from root values to a t/c of 0.025 at the tip.

stator_tc_distribution.quote: Maximum thickness to chord ratio was set to vary linearly from 0.04 at the hub to 0.075 at the tip ... At the tip sections, maximum thickness was set at midchord.

rotor1_partspan_shroud_location.quote: Blades of the first rotor have a partspan shroud at 61 percent span from the hub

stacking.value: radial line through c.g. of root conical section
stacking.quote: For manufacturing purposes, the airfoil sections were redefined on planes normal to the stacking line, a radial line through the center of gravity of the root conical section.

tip_clearance.quote: Two proximity detectors, located over the tips of each rotor blade at midchord were used to monitor blade tip clearance. (no clearance values printed)

instrument_station_6.quote: 6 Rotor 1 inlet (2.25 in. upstream of rotor 1)

value.7: Rotor 1 exit (approx. halfway between rotor 1 trailing edge and stator 1 leading edge)
value.8: Stator 1 exit (halfway between stator 1 trailing edge and rotor 2 leading edge)
value.10: Fan discharge (within 1/2 chord downstream of stator 2)

instrument_stations_other.quote: TABLE IV. - PERFORMANCE AND BLADE-ELEMENT INSTRUMENTATION

measurement_streamlines.unit: percent of passage height at rotor 1 TE
measurement_streamlines.quote: The nine radial positions of each axial station are defined by the intersection of the axial station and the design streamlines which pass through 5, 10, 15, 30, 50, 70, 85, 90, and 95 percent of the passage height at the first-stage-rotor trailing edge.

stator1_reset_test.quote: A 5 deg closed reset of the first-stage stator eliminated second-stage flutter

forward_support_struts.unit: inches (0.356 m) upstream of the rotor leading edge; 10 struts
forward_support_struts.quote: Ten struts, 14 inches (0. 356 m) upstream of the rotor leading edge, supported the forward bearing and the assembly for the strain-gage slip ring.

rear_support_struts.unit: inches (0.28 m) downstream of the stator trailing edge; 8 struts
rear_support_struts.quote: Eight struts located 11 inches (0. 28 m) downstream of the stator trailing edge supported the rear bearing.

instrument_station_10_position.quote: 10 Fan discharge (within 1/2 chord downstream of stator 2)

stator2_leading_edge_probe_spans.unit: percent of span; two circumferential positions
stator2_leading_edge_probe_spans.quote: Stator 2 leading-edge probes  Total pressure, P  Two circumferential positions and five radial positions (10, 30, 50, 70, and 90 percent of span)

blade_edge_stations_for_data_reduction.value: slanted straight lines approximating manufactured blade-edge meridional profiles
blade_edge_stations_for_data_reduction.quote: The blade-edge stations that were used as input to the flow-field calculation were slanted straight lines closely approximating the meridional profiles of the manufactured blade edges.

instrument_plane_axial_positions_figure.quote: Figure 7. - Axial location of instrumentation planes. (drawing with axis 'Axial distance, z, in.' from -50 to 20 and z, m; no tabulated station positions; only station 6 is stated in text)
